decision_conditions:
S73 - CONSENT LIMITED TO THAT OF ORIGINAL PERMISSION:  The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of 16 May 2028.

REASON: To ensure the commencement timescale for the development is not extended beyond that of the original planning permission granted on 16 May 2025 LBI ref: P2025/0626/FUL. Furthermore, to comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
description:
Section 73 Application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary Condition 2 (Approved Plans) of Planning Permission P2025/0626/FUL dated 16 May 2025 for ‘Erection of a part single/part double storey rear extension, pitched roof extension behind parapet including roof light, replacement and repair of sash windows to front/rear elevation, plastic pipework replaced with cast iron alternatives, refurbishment of existing front door/fanlight and iron balustrades to first floor windows and removal of upvc window and door’ 
The proposal seeks to repair and partial replacement of two front timber sash windows to double-glazed timber sash windows
